race.comment: CHURCHILL'S CHOICE (11) Group winning mare set to peak third up and profiles well with the blistering early tempo. Looked to be struggling on the home turn before she picked up late to run sixth over 1600m in the G3 Angst Stakes at this track. Key jockey change today and can finish over the top of these. GRINGOTTS (1) chasing his third straight win in this race and looks to get his chance again with the 62kg. Hit the line well when seventh over 1400m in the G3 Alan Brown Stakes at Rosehill. Set to peak in what looks a stronger race this year. FORMAL DISPLAY (2) rewarded for his consistency second up with a game victory in the G3 Alan Brown Stakes at Rosehill over 1400m. Can stalk the fast tempo and figure prominently. HELLSING (9) finds an easier race today after he covered plenty of ground in the run when fourteenth over 1600m in the G1 Toorak Handicap at Caulfield. Scone Cup winner not to be overlooked at the good each way price from the good gate. The place chances don't end there.
